fair_value.method: Forward P/E: by Sep-2027 the market prices FY2028 EPS; I haircut the implied ~$10.5 street path to $10.40 for memory-cost margin pressure (FY26E ~$8.86 incl. ~$0.11 one-off tariff refund; FY27 consensus $9.57; ~2.5%/yr buyback accretion) and apply 30x (above Apple's ~27-29x five-year average for services mix/buybacks, below today's ~35.6x FY27 given a Fed-hiking, rising-yield backdrop) = ~$312.

bear.story: DRAM contract prices up ~33% for 2027 and memory reaching ~40%+ of iPhone BOM push gross margin toward 44-45%; price hikes dent units (esp. China); FY28 EPS ~$9.3 and multiple derates to ~27x amid Fed hikes and a DOJ appeal threatening the ~$20B Google payment.

base.story: iPhone 18/Duo cycle and price increases broadly offset memory costs; revenue grows high single digits, EPS FY28 ~$10.4, buybacks continue; multiple compresses modestly from ~36x to ~32-33x, leaving the stock roughly flat plus dividend.

bull.story: New Siri/Apple Intelligence and foldable iPhone Duo drive a genuine upgrade supercycle (Pro wait times already longer than iPhone 17), pricing power holds margins ~47%+, services reaccelerate; FY28 EPS ~$11.3 at ~38x.

thesis_break_reason: A ~25% drop to ~$255 (near the 52-week low of $243 and ~27x FY27 consensus) would, outside a broad market selloff, most likely mean the memory-cost squeeze is overwhelming pricing power (gross margin guide in the low-to-mid 40s, EPS estimates cut toward flat) or that the Google default-search payment is being lost, rather than normal 25%-vol noise.

catalysts.event: iPhone Duo (foldable) launch/pre-orders; iPhone 18 Pro sell-through data
Q4 FY26 earnings (est.) and Dec-quarter gross margin guide; ex-tariff-refund margin run-rate
Fed rate-hike decisions; 10y yield path (valuation multiple risk)
Q1 FY27 holiday-quarter earnings: iPhone units after $100+ price hikes, memory cost pass-through
DC Circuit rulings on Google search remedy appeals (Apple default-search payments ~$20B/yr)
Q2 FY27 earnings and annual capital return/buyback authorization
WWDC: Apple Intelligence/Siri roadmap under CEO John Ternus
Q3 FY27 earnings; FY28 memory contract pricing visibility

key_uncertainties: Magnitude and duration of DRAM/NAND cost inflation (industry shortage projected to persist into 2028) vs Apple's ability to pass it through
Whether ~36x forward P/E holds in a rate-hiking environment
Durability of iPhone 18/Duo demand after price increases; mixed channel checks (JPM/Evercore strong, UBS muted)
Services growth slowdown (Q3 miss) and Google search payment/App Store regulatory risk
Execution under new CEO John Ternus (since Sep 1, 2026)
Greater China share (Q3 revenue $18.8B vs $19.6B expected)
reasoning: Fundamentals are strong but largely priced: Q3 FY26 revenue +16% to $109.4B, EPS $2.02 (+29%, incl. $0.11 tariff refund and ~2pts GM help), Sep-qtr guide +9-11% with GM 47-48% as memory and advanced-node supply constrain; FY26 EPS ~$8.86, FY27 consensus ~$9.57 (+8%). At $341 the stock is ~35.6x FY27 and ~39x trailing, at an all-time high after +35% in a year, with a ~$5T cap. Street targets cluster at ~$328-342 (range $245-400), i.e. little upside even from sell-side. Headwinds: DRAM quoted +33% for 2027 with memory potentially ~40%+ of iPhone Pro BOM, Jefferies at Underperform, the Fed signalling hikes with 10y yields jumping, and appeals that could threaten Google TAC. Tailwinds: early iPhone 18 Pro lead times above last year, Siri AI relaunch, foldable Duo, relentless buybacks (~$62B in 9 months). My explicit fair value (30x x $10.40 FY28E = ~$312) is ~8% below spot, but momentum, buybacks and a typical positive equity drift pull the median back toward spot; I set the median ~$338 (slightly below $341, P(>=341)=0.485). Scenario-weighted mean ~$340 (25% bear $250 / 50% base $340 / 25% bull $430). Dispersion uses ~27% annual vol (given 25% realized, bumped for multiple-compression risk and earnings/memory event risk) on a lognormal, with a slightly fattened left tail (derating from 36x can be abrupt). Resulting 10-90% range roughly $239-$450.
